outcome_detail: Ken Paxton defeated incumbent John Cornyn in the 2026 Texas Republican U.S. Senate primary runoff, winning approximately 63.8% to Cornyn's ~36% (margin ~28 points). Cornyn LOST.
source_label: The Texas Tribune - 'Ken Paxton defeats John Cornyn in Texas U.S. Senate GOP runoff' (also corroborated by NBC News, CNN, CNBC, Houston Public Media, Al Jazeera)
reasoning: The market resolves YES only if Cornyn WON by >= 9 points. Multiple major outlets (Texas Tribune, NBC News, CNN, CNBC, Houston Public Media, Al Jazeera) called the May 26, 2026 runoff for Ken Paxton, who won roughly 63.8% of ~1.38M votes vs. Cornyn's ~36% (a ~28-point Paxton margin). Cornyn lost; he was the first Texas incumbent senator to lose renomination since 1970. Since Cornyn did not win at all, the >=9-point Cornyn-victory bracket is not met. Resolution: NO.
